# API reference

<!-- Generated by `python -m tests.api_reference --write`; do not edit. -->

Every public symbol of `kumo.pytorch.api`, `kumo.pytorch.build` and `kumo.pytorch.datasets`, with its signature, parameters, behavior and refusals, generated from the docstrings. Import declarations and lifecycle functions from `kumo.pytorch.api`.

The [guide](../README.md) explains the concepts in order. The behavior spec, with tested golden examples, is in [`conformance/spec/guarantees/`](../../conformance/spec/guarantees/).

| Page | Covers |
| --- | --- |
| [Schema and types](schema.md) | Stored tables, their scalar column types, keys, relationships and clocks. |
| [Samples](samples.md) | What one example may read at its prediction time: rows, values, calculations, histories, graph neighborhoods, candidates and generated targets. |
| [Batches](batches.md) | Named model inputs: sources, ordered fields, row and history arrangements, layouts, batching limits and the emitted `Batch`. |
| [Encodings and ID spaces](encodings.md) | Explicit value encoders, shared encoders, final ID spaces and field-name IDs. |
| [Targets](targets.md) | Explicitly encoded labels and input-derived objectives. |
| [Lifecycle](lifecycle.md) | The contract, validation, preparation, anchors, fitting, batch iteration and previews. |
| [Datasets and engines](engines.md) | Where table bytes live, which engine executes the contract, and what it supports. |
| [Artifacts and serving](artifacts-and-serving.md) | Saving and loading fitted state, model weights, and serving from caller-supplied rows. |
| [Object-linked authoring (experimental)](authoring.md) | `kumo.pytorch.build` links declarations through Python objects and lowers them to the ordinary `DataLoaderSpec`. It is experimental: names and arguments may change. |
| [Example datasets](datasets.md) | Seeded synthetic datasets with planted signals, used by the example notebooks. |
